name: Taguchi Jinta
source: Kenta's father. He is aware that his son is too dense to realize that a girl has fallen in love with him, so he organizes that Kenta lives with candidates to be his "mother" although, in reality, they are candidates to be his wife. Due to working at his company, he is never at home.
